name: What is the typical process for storm damage repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for storm damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process begins with an initial inspection to assess the damage and create a repair plan. This is often followed by emergency services like board-ups or water extraction to secure the property and prevent secondary damage. After mitigation, comprehensive repairs, cleaning, and restoration work are performed to return your property to its pre-storm condition. Throughout the process, reputable companies can help coordinate with your insurance company.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, emergency services, comprehensive repairs, cleaning, and restoration, often with insurance coordination.
